outcome: Rate of pharmacologic treatment for NAS
cohort: 3364 hospitalized infants with NAS born at ≥36 weeks' gestation
finding: Among infants born at ≥36 weeks' gestation with NAS, antenatal buprenorphine exposure was associated with a shorter length of stay compared to antenatal methadone exposure.
mod_finding: Infants born via cesarean section had a shorter length of stay if their mothers were exposed to antenatal buprenorphine compared to antenatal methadone exposure.
